g.title: PS1
g.text: 12 V DC, 3.0 A, 36 W, LPS (D017). Measured 12.27 V, no load.
Cable cut and split: + and - labeled after a multimeter check.
No adjustable current limit. Worst case about 1.8 A (D021).
Plug in after the laptop USB, unplug first (D021).

g.title: W40
g.text: Adapter cable, split into two wires

g.title: RAIL_12V_UNSW
g.text: On the robot, before SW1. Feeds encoder

g.title: BUS_GND
g.text: Same bus as sheets 01 and 02. One common ground:
12 V adapter, both converters and the Leonardo (D005)

g.title: SW1
g.text: Cut-off switch, SCI R13-66 rocker, SPST
Lab part, 2 terminals: either one can be the input.
In the + wire only, never in GND (D005).
Off: motors, servos and actuator lose power.

g.title: PS2
g.text: Module datasheet R1.2: input 4-35 V, at least 1.5 V above
the output. 2 A rated. IN- and OUT- are the same ground.
Set to 3.3 V with the trimmer (D021). Measure OUT before
connecting the edge sensors: VL53L4CD AVDD 2.6-3.5 V,

g.title: PS3
g.text: Matek manual: both G pads are one common ground.
No reverse-polarity protection: check IN is +.
Measure OUT before connecting the servos (D014).

g.title: RAIL_5V_SERVO
g.text: U2/U3 VCC1 with C1/C3, and U2 VCC2

g.title: LAPTOP
g.text: Powers and programs the Leonardo, logs data (D004, D005, D020)

g.title: U1
g.text: 3V3 pin (50 mA max) feeds +3V3_LOGIC: TFT RESET
pull-up and LED only. 5V pin feeds +5V_USB: display
VCC and actuator pot. GND pin joins BUS_GND (sheet 01, W1).
